description_en: Removes a DNAT entry from a Smart Access Gateway (SAG) instance
description_zh: 删除指定智能接入网关实例绑定的DNAT条目
kebab_example: aliyun smartag delete-dnat-entry --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --sag-id sag-ntwc9r1a6z3xz00000 --dnat-entry-id fwd-kxe4fq3xuzczze0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteDnatEntry

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region where the SAG instance is deployed.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
智能接入网关实例所属地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the SAG instance.

Only SAG instances used to manage SAG devices support DNAT
parameters.name: sag_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the DNAT entry
parameters.help_zh:
DNAT条目ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/125450.html接口获取智能接入网关实例的DNAT条目ID
parameters.name: dnat_entry_id
